summary: Full-stack testing of CleanNode dashboard. Backend: 39 pytest cases across auth (JWT bearer, roles, bad creds, bad/no token, bcrypt $2b$ hash), snapshot (source=firebase, 4 facilities/16 cubicles, SRS PCI bands 75/45), facilities + detail + 404, alerts, anomalies, history (+facility filter), analytics (24 hourly buckets, per-facility), heatmap (lat/lng per facility), staff (no _id/password_hash leak), assignments GET/PATCH with MongoDB override persistence verified via GET+snapshot, settings GET/PUT with admin-only RBAC (staff=403) and 422 validation - ALL 39 PASSED. Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390): unauthenticated / redirects to /login; invalid creds show login-error and stay on login; admin + staff login work; token stored in localStorage cn_token; invalid/expired token is cleared and redirects to /login; all 12 nav routes render with data (live-table 16 rows, alerts/maintenance/anomalies 16 items each, heatmap 4 markers + area drill-down cards, analytics 5 recharts, facility detail 6 cubicle cards + PCI/gas trend chart + duty list); duty status change via Select fires PATCH, shows success toast and persists after reload; history facility filter narrows 90 -> 17 rows; admin settings save persists after reload; staff settings read-only with warning and no Save button; logout clears token and returns to /login; mobile drawer nav works. No console errors, no 5xx. No blocking defects found.

minor.issue: No rate limiting / brute-force lockout - unlimited wrong-password attempts are accepted (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails). Design uses Bearer JWT in localStorage instead of httpOnly cookies, so cookie/CSRF hardening is absent by design.
allow_origins defaults to '*' (CORS_ORIGINS unset). Fine because allow_credentials=False, but explicit origins are preferable.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler.
Low-PCI threshold hardcoded to 55 instead of reading configurable settings (pci_moderate_min / danger_zone_pci), so Settings changes do not affect alert selection.

ui_bugs.issue: Email/password inputs are pre-filled with real admin credentials (admin@cleannode.in / admin123) and demo credentials are printed on the page - acceptable for demo, but should be removed for production.
'Duty assignments for this facility' list has no data-testid on the container/rows (hinders automated assertions).

issues: Map is a synthetic dotted grid (no real map tiles); markers derive x/y from lat/lng so positions look arbitrary and can crowd. Functional per FR11 but visually approximate.

Settings nav item is hidden for staff (adminOnly), yet the page is reachable by direct URL and shows the read-only view - inconsistent with the spec statement 'Staff sees read-only fields and a warning'. Decide: show nav item for staff, or drop the read-only view.

action_items: Optional: add login rate limiting/lockout on /api/auth/login
Optional: make /api/alerts low-PCI cutoff use configurable settings instead of hardcoded 55
Optional: expose Settings nav for staff (read-only) or restrict route entirely for consistency
Optional: remove prefilled/demo credentials from the login form before production
critical_code_review_comments: server.py alerts() uses magic number 55 for the low-PCI cutoff while thresholds are otherwise configurable in /api/settings.
Files are all under 400 lines, async Mongo usage is correct, _id is excluded from all responses, env vars used everywhere - no structural issues found.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test artifacts cleaned up: assignment override for duty 1786987280475 deleted and settings restored to defaults (gas_threshold=2500).

rca_of_the_issue: No defects requiring RCA; all reported items are hardening/UX polish observations.
